name: Frozen 2D KdV-type resolution transfer

frequency_direct.shared_parameters: All original learned tensors are frozen, without resizing or fitting
frequency_direct.linear_extension: Reuse integer Fourier modes in the open native Nyquist band; zero multiplier outside abs(kx)<32 and ky<32 at N=128; native N=64 calls unchanged original implementation
frequency_direct.offset_scaling: Orthonormal FFT offset multiplied by target_N / 64 in two dimensions
frequency_direct.filter: Same physical wavenumber attenuation: frequency coordinate 2*k/64 at every target grid
frequency_direct.runtime_changes: Rebuild grid masks, spectral indexing, physical-frequency buffers and zero-input cache only
frequency_direct.scope: Explicit runtime extension convention, not an already verified native arbitrary-resolution implementation

project_to64: Periodic Fourier resampling to 64, unchanged original model, Fourier resampling back at each step

reference.physical_coefficients: Convert original difficulty gammas/deltas at N=64 once, then fix normalized physical coefficients, domain length=1 and output dt=1 across grids
reference.initial_conditions: Same existing test ICs, periodically Fourier resampled
reference.validation: Three independent validation ICs (seed 250927), horizon 200; 128-grid 64-vs-128 substeps and 128-vs-256 spatial resolution at 128 substeps
reference.gate: Maximum per-time relative L2 discrepancy <= 0.01 in each comparison; fail closed, do not tune against model errors
reference.projection: Fourier resample reference128 onto each evaluation grid

aggregation: Mean over all 30 ICs per step, then geometric mean over specified time window, separately for each training seed; no survivor-only averaging
checks: Fourier resampling analytic and scipy agreement
interpretation: Can establish empirical transfer for these grids and this PDE only; does not prove arbitrary discretization, geometry or parameter generalization
